facts.fact: MountInasa rises333m and its summit observatory provides a panoramic view of the city, coastline and port; distant visibility depends on clear weather.

Inasa & Nagasaki Ropeway （イナサヤマ） 中文繁體 中文简体 한국어 Selected as one of the Top 3 Night Views in the World in 2021 with Shanghai and Monaco Area Nagasaki City Category Nature＆Hot Spring 647834 views View in slideshow mode Rising 333 meters above sea level in the center of Nagasaki, Mount Inasa Park in the Inasa mountain range is a natural park beloved by the residents of the city. It is renowned for its displays of azaleas in the spring. The summit features a glass-enclosed circular domed lookout from which one can enjoy a 360-degree view of the spectacular scenery. On clear days, one can even see Mt. Unzen, the Amakusa area, and the Goto chain of islands. The summit can be reached by a ropeway operating from Fuchi
